unscramble-words.result: A list of every English word your letters make, longest first, with the letters a blank filled in marked.
unscramble-words.note: Each tile is used once. If you have only one E, words with two Es need a blank for the second one.
unscramble-words.s1t: Open the Word unscrambler on cv.cm
unscramble-words.s1b: Have your letters ready: the tiles on your rack, the letters of an anagram, or the letters you can see in a puzzle.
unscramble-words.s2t: Type the letters and the blanks
unscramble-words.s2b: Type the letters in any order; case does not matter. For a blank tile, type ?. Up to three blanks are allowed, and the letter each blank stands for is highlighted in the results.
unscramble-words.s3t: Read the list from the top
unscramble-words.s3b: Words appear as you type, grouped by length with the longest group first. A group labelled Uses every letter holds the full anagrams.
unscramble-words.s4b: Pick a word length when a crossword gives you the number of squares. Starts with, Contains and Ends with keep only words that fit letters already on the board, such as words ending in ING.
unscramble-words.s5t: Check that the word fits your game
unscramble-words.s5b: The list is ENABLE, a public-domain word list that many word games use, with 172,823 words. Games have their own dictionaries, so a rare word may still be refused; when in doubt, play the commoner one.
unscramble-words.s6b: Copy words puts the whole list on the clipboard, one group per length, to keep for later or share with the other players.
unscramble-words.diagram1: A blank (?) can stand for any one letter.
unscramble-words.diagram2: Filters keep only words that fit the board.

calculate-concrete.name: How to calculate concrete
calculate-concrete.blurb: Yards, metres and bags for a pour.
calculate-concrete.title: How to calculate how much concrete you need
calculate-concrete.lead: Order too little concrete and the pour stops halfway; order too much and you pay to throw it away. You will measure the job, put every size in one unit, work out the volume, add a margin for waste and turn it into bags or a ready-mix order.
calculate-concrete.result: The volume of concrete in cubic yards, cubic feet and cubic metres, and the number of premix bags to buy.
calculate-concrete.note: Measure the depth at several points. Ground is rarely level, and an extra half inch over a whole slab adds about 12% more concrete.
calculate-concrete.s1t: Open the Concrete calculator on cv.cm
calculate-concrete.s1b: Choose what you are pouring: a slab or patio, a footing, a wall, round columns or post holes, a hollow tube or a set of stairs.
calculate-concrete.s2t: Measure and put every size in one unit
calculate-concrete.s2b: Volume is length × width × thickness, but only when all three are in the same unit. A 10 × 10 ft slab 4 in thick is 10 × 10 × 0.333 ft = 33.3 ft³. The calculator lets each size have its own unit and converts for you.
calculate-concrete.s3t: Convert to the unit you order in
calculate-concrete.s3b: In the US concrete is sold by the cubic yard: divide cubic feet by 27, so 33.3 ft³ is 1.23 yd³. Elsewhere it is sold by the cubic metre; 1 yd³ is 0.765 m³.
calculate-concrete.s4b: Add 5% for formed slabs on a flat base and 10% or more for uneven ground, footings dug by hand or a first pour. The calculator adds 10% unless you change it.
calculate-concrete.s5b: An 80 lb bag of premix makes about 0.60 ft³, a 60 lb bag 0.45 ft³ and a 40 lb bag 0.30 ft³. Divide and round up: the 10 × 10 ft slab with 10% waste needs 62 bags of 80 lb.
calculate-concrete.s6b: Bags suit small jobs such as post holes and steps. From about 1 yd³ (0.75 m³), a ready-mix truck is usually cheaper, quicker and more even than mixing dozens of bags by hand.
calculate-concrete.diagram1: Volume = length × width × thickness, all in feet.
calculate-concrete.diagram2: Add waste, then divide by what one bag makes.

graph-functions.name: How to graph a function online
graph-functions.blurb: Type y = f(x), then read the points.
graph-functions.title: How to graph a function online
graph-functions.lead: A graph shows at a glance where a function is positive, where it turns and where it crosses zero. You will type a function the way a calculator reads it, choose a good window, read values off the curve and find its zeros and crossings.
graph-functions.result: A graph of one or more functions with their zeros, y-intercepts and crossing points listed.
graph-functions.note: Trigonometric functions use radians here, as in most graphing tools: sin(x) crosses zero at multiples of π ≈ 3.14, not at 180.
graph-functions.s1t: Open the Graphing calculator on cv.cm
graph-functions.s1b: The page starts with two examples, y = x^2 − 2 and y = sin(x), so you can see how a curve and its points look before typing your own.
graph-functions.s2t: Type the function the calculator's way
graph-functions.s2b: Write powers with ^ (x^2), roots as sqrt(x), absolute values as abs(x) or |x|, and use brackets for anything that belongs together: 1/(x + 1) is not 1/x + 1. 2x and 3(x + 1) multiply without a × sign.
graph-functions.s3b: Add a function gives a new row in its own colour, up to six. Untick a row to hide its curve without deleting what you typed.
graph-functions.s4b: Drag to move and use the mouse wheel, a pinch or the + and − buttons to zoom. Large values need a wider view: y = x^3 at x = 10 is 1,000. Reset returns to −10 to 10.
graph-functions.s5b: Under the graph the calculator lists where each curve crosses the x-axis (its zeros), where it crosses the y-axis, and where two curves meet. For y = x^2 − 2 the zeros are ±1.4142136, which is ±√2.
graph-functions.s6t: Trace values and save the picture
graph-functions.s6b: Point at the graph, or tap it, to read x and each function's value there. Download PNG saves the graph for homework or notes.
graph-functions.diagram1: Type what you mean, the way the calculator reads it.
graph-functions.diagram2: Zeros are where the curve meets the x-axis.

play-piano-online.name: How to play piano online
play-piano-online.blurb: Your computer keyboard as a piano.
play-piano-online.title: How to play piano online with your computer keyboard
play-piano-online.lead: You do not need a real piano to try a melody, check a note or practise a scale. You will learn which computer keys play which notes, find middle C, play chords, hold notes with the pedal and record what you play.
play-piano-online.result: A playable piano in the browser, with the notes named on the keys and a take you can play back.
play-piano-online.note: Many computer keyboards register only three or four keys pressed together, so a big chord may drop a note. A touch screen does not have that limit.
play-piano-online.s1t: Open the Virtual piano on cv.cm
play-piano-online.s1b: Click, tap or press a key. Browsers only allow sound after a key press or click, so the first note also turns the sound on.
play-piano-online.s2b: The bottom row Z X C V B N M plays the white keys C to B of one octave, with S D G H J for the black keys. The row Q W E R T Y U plays the octave above, with 2 3 5 6 7 for its black keys. Choose Computer keys under Key labels to see them on the piano.
play-piano-online.s3t: Pick a sound and a range
play-piano-online.s3b: Choose piano, electric piano, organ or synth, and how many octaves to show. The ◀ and ▶ buttons move the keyboard down or up an octave; the computer keys move with it.
play-piano-online.s4b: The white key just left of each pair of black keys is C. Middle C is C4; with labels on Note names it is marked on the keys, or choose Do Re Mi.
play-piano-online.s5t: Play chords and use the pedal
play-piano-online.s5b: Press several keys at once for a chord: C, E and G make C major. Hold Space as a sustain pedal so notes ring on after you let go, or tick Sustain to keep it on.
play-piano-online.s6b: Press Record, play, then Stop. Play repeats your take with the same timing; change the sound and play it again to hear it on another instrument. Clear starts over.
play-piano-online.diagram1: Two rows of computer keys play two octaves.
play-piano-online.diagram2: C is the white key left of the two black keys.

find-slope.name: How to find the slope of a line
find-slope.blurb: Rise over run, and the line's equation.
find-slope.title: How to find the slope of a line from two points
find-slope.lead: Slope tells you how steep a line is and which way it goes: how much y changes for each step in x. You will work it out from two points, write the line's equation in the three usual forms and check special cases such as vertical lines.
find-slope.result: The slope as a fraction and decimal, the line's equation, its intercepts, angle, the distance between the points and their midpoint.
find-slope.note: Keep the points in the same order on top and bottom: (y₂ − y₁) over (x₂ − x₁). Swapping only one of them flips the sign.
find-slope.s1t: Open the Slope calculator on cv.cm
find-slope.s1b: You need two points on the line, such as (1, 2) and (4, 8). Coordinates can be whole numbers, decimals or fractions.
find-slope.s2t: Find the rise and the run
find-slope.s2b: The rise is the change in y: 8 − 2 = 6. The run is the change in x: 4 − 1 = 3. The slope is rise over run: m = 6 ÷ 3 = 2, so y goes up 2 for every 1 to the right.
find-slope.s3b: A positive slope rises from left to right, a negative one falls, and a slope of 0 is a horizontal line. When the run is 0 the line is vertical and the slope is undefined.
find-slope.s4b: Put one point into y = mx + b and solve for b: 2 = 2 × 1 + b, so b = 0 and the line is y = 2x. The calculator keeps fractions exact, so a slope of 2/3 is not rounded to 0.67.
find-slope.s5b: Point-slope form uses a point directly: y − 2 = 2(x − 1). Standard form puts x and y on one side with whole numbers: 2x − y = 0. All three describe the same line.
find-slope.s6b: The angle (63.43° here) and the grade (200%) describe steepness for ramps and roads. The distance between the points is √(Δx² + Δy²) = √45 = 3√5, and the midpoint is (2.5, 5).
find-slope.diagram1: Slope is rise over run between the two points.
find-slope.diagram2: Three ways to write the same line.

play-sudoku.name: How to play sudoku
play-sudoku.blurb: The rule, scanning, notes and getting unstuck.
play-sudoku.title: How to play sudoku
play-sudoku.lead: Sudoku needs no maths, only logic. You will learn the one rule, the two ways every beginner finds digits, how to keep notes, and what to do when you are stuck, then solve a full puzzle.
play-sudoku.result: A solved sudoku and a method you can use on harder puzzles.
play-sudoku.note: Never guess. A well-made sudoku has one solution, and every digit can be found by logic.
play-sudoku.s1b: Start with an easy puzzle. The digits in black are given; you fill the empty cells. Tap a cell, then a number, or type on a keyboard.
play-sudoku.s2b: Each row, each column and each 3 × 3 box must hold 1 to 9 exactly once. So a digit already in a row cannot appear again anywhere in that row, and the same for columns and boxes.
play-sudoku.s3t: Find the only cell for a digit
play-sudoku.s3b: Pick a digit, say 5, and a box without one. Every row and column that already has a 5 rules out its cells in that box. When only one cell is left, the 5 goes there.
play-sudoku.s4t: Find the only digit for a cell
play-sudoku.s4b: Look at one empty cell and cross off every digit in its row, column and box. If only one digit is left, write it in. Busy rows and boxes are the best place to look.
play-sudoku.s5b: On medium and harder puzzles, turn on Notes and write the possible digits in small. Each time you place a digit, the tool removes it from the notes it rules out, so new single options appear.
play-sudoku.s6b: Digits that clash in a row, column or box are underlined. Show mistakes compares your digits with the answer, and Hint fills one cell. Undo takes back any move.
play-sudoku.diagram1: The rule: 1 to 9 once in every row, column and box.
play-sudoku.diagram2: The 5s in two rows leave one cell for 5 in the box.

play-tic-tac-toe.name: How to win at tic-tac-toe
play-tic-tac-toe.blurb: Best first move, forks and blocks.
play-tic-tac-toe.title: How to win at tic-tac-toe and never lose
play-tic-tac-toe.lead: Tic-tac-toe is solved: with perfect play it is always a draw. You will learn the opening that gives your opponent the most chances to slip, how to win with a fork, and how to make sure you never lose.
play-tic-tac-toe.result: A plan for X and for O that wins against weak play and draws against perfect play.
play-tic-tac-toe.note: Against the hard computer the best result is a draw. Practise forks on easy and medium.
play-tic-tac-toe.s1b: Choose Against the computer and Medium, and play as X so you move first. X always starts.
play-tic-tac-toe.s2b: A corner is the strongest first move. The only safe reply for O is the centre; any edge or corner reply lets X force a win.
play-tic-tac-toe.s3b: Before every move, ask: can I complete three in a row now? If not, can my opponent complete three next turn? Win if you can, block if you must.
play-tic-tac-toe.s4b: A fork is a move that makes two lines of two at once. Your opponent can block only one, so you win with the other. Opposite corners are the classic way to set one up.
play-tic-tac-toe.s5b: If X takes a corner, take the centre. If X takes the centre, take a corner. If X has opposite corners and you hold the centre, play an edge, not a corner, or X forks you.
play-tic-tac-toe.s6b: Switch to Hard. The computer plays perfectly, so every game should end in a draw. If you lose, look at the board: you missed a block or allowed a fork.
play-tic-tac-toe.diagram1: First moves for X, strongest to weakest.
play-tic-tac-toe.diagram2: A fork: two lines of two, only one can be blocked.

test-color-blindness.name: How to test for color blindness
test-color-blindness.blurb: Set up the screen, read plates, understand types.
test-color-blindness.title: How to test for color blindness online
test-color-blindness.lead: Colour vision deficiency is common: about 1 in 12 men and 1 in 200 women have the red–green kind. You will set up your screen, take a short dot-plate test and learn what protan, deutan and tritan results mean.
test-color-blindness.result: A score for each kind of plate and an idea of whether to book a proper eye test.
test-color-blindness.note: A screen test is a screening, not a diagnosis. Only an eye-care professional can confirm the type and degree.
test-color-blindness.s1t: Open the Color blindness test on cv.cm
test-color-blindness.s1b: Use a computer, tablet or phone screen in a room without coloured lighting. Wear your usual glasses.
test-color-blindness.s2b: Each plate is a circle of dots with a two-digit number. The number's dots differ from the background in a colour difference only some cones see; the dots' brightness is mixed, so the number cannot be found by lightness.
test-color-blindness.s3b: Turn brightness up and switch off night mode, blue-light filters, colour filters and dark-mode tinting. These change the colours and can hide numbers.
test-color-blindness.s4b: Type the number you see within a few seconds, or tap I see no number. Do not lean in or tilt the screen to hunt for it. The first plate is a check that everyone can read.
test-color-blindness.s5b: You get a score for red (protan), green (deutan) and blue–yellow (tritan) plates, from clear to very faint. Missing several plates of one kind points to that type. Missing only the faintest plates is common.
test-color-blindness.s6b: If the result shows a deficiency, take the test again on another screen. If it repeats, see an optometrist, who can test you with printed plates and an anomaloscope.
test-color-blindness.diagram1: The number differs from the background only in hue on one confusion line.
test-color-blindness.diagram2: Three kinds of cones and the deficiency when one is missing or weak.

convert-military-time.name: How to convert military time
convert-military-time.title: How to convert military time to standard time
convert-military-time.lead: Military time counts the hours of the day from 00 to 23, so there is no AM or PM. You will convert in both directions, handle midnight and noon, say times out loud and know what Zulu time means.
convert-military-time.result: Any time converted between military and 12-hour form, and said correctly.
convert-military-time.note: Military time is written with four digits and no colon: 0930, not 9:30.
convert-military-time.s1t: Open the Military time converter on cv.cm
convert-military-time.s1b: Type a time in either form, such as 1430 or 2:30 pm. The conversion appears as you type, with a chart below.
convert-military-time.s2b: From 1300 to 2359, subtract 12 from the first two digits and add PM: 1430 → 14 − 12 = 2 → 2:30 PM. Going the other way, add 12 to any PM hour from 1 to 11: 7:15 PM → 1915.
convert-military-time.s3b: Midnight is 0000 (12:00 AM) and noon is 1200 (12:00 PM). Hours 0001–0059 are 12:01–12:59 AM. Morning hours keep their digits: 0830 is 8:30 AM.
convert-military-time.s4b: Read the digits as two pairs and add hours: 1430 is "fourteen thirty hours". Whole hours use hundred: 0800 is "zero eight hundred hours". Leading zeros are said as zero.
convert-military-time.s5b: Military and aviation schedules often use Zulu time, which is UTC, marked with a Z: 1430Z. The converter shows the current Zulu time next to your own.
convert-military-time.s6b: For quick look-ups, the chart lists every hour from 12 AM (0000) to 11 PM (2300). Keep the page open on shifts or bookmark it.
convert-military-time.diagram1: After noon, subtract 12 from the hours.

predict-child-height.name: How to predict your child's adult height
predict-child-height.blurb: Parents' formula and growth chart percentiles.
predict-child-height.title: How to predict your child's adult height
predict-child-height.lead: Height depends mostly on genes, so the parents' heights give a good first guess. You will work out the mid-parental target and its range, then use your child's growth chart percentile for a second estimate, and see how far to trust each.
predict-child-height.result: Two estimates of adult height and a range most children fall within.
predict-child-height.note: These are estimates. Nutrition, health, sleep and the timing of puberty all move the final height within the range.
predict-child-height.s1t: Open the Height calculator on cv.cm
predict-child-height.s1b: Choose centimetres or feet and inches, whether your child is a boy or a girl, and have both parents' heights ready, measured without shoes.
predict-child-height.s2b: Add the father's and mother's heights. For a boy add 13 cm (5 in), for a girl subtract 13 cm, then halve it. Father 178 cm and mother 165 cm give a boy (178 + 165 + 13) ÷ 2 = 178 cm.
predict-child-height.s3b: About 95% of children end up within 8.5 cm (about 3.5 in) of the target, so the 178 cm boy's range is roughly 169.5–186.5 cm. Siblings can land at opposite ends.
predict-child-height.s4b: Stand them against a wall without shoes, heels together, and mark the top of the head with a flat object. Enter the height and their age in years and months.
predict-child-height.s5b: The calculator finds your child's percentile on the CDC growth charts. Children usually keep roughly the same percentile, so the adult height on that percentile at age 20 is a second estimate.
predict-child-height.s6b: If both estimates agree, the prediction is more reliable. If they differ, puberty timing is a common reason. Measure every six months; a child who drops across percentile lines should see a doctor.
predict-child-height.diagram1: The mid-parental formula for a boy and a girl.
predict-child-height.diagram2: Following the same percentile to age 20.

heic-to-jpg.title: HEIC to JPG
heic-to-jpg.lede: iPhone photos are often HEIC. Export a JPG here, then open it on the computer you will send it to. Firefox on Windows may leave the preview blank.

webp-to-png.title: WebP to PNG
webp-to-png.lede: Chrome often saves WebP. Export PNG when another app rejects it. PNG can keep a transparent edge. JPG cannot.

png-to-jpg.title: PNG to JPG
png-to-jpg.lede: JPG is smaller than a photo PNG. A transparent PNG has no JPG equivalent: clear pixels become a solid background, often black.

jpg-to-png.title: JPG to PNG
jpg-to-png.lede: PNG will not invent a clear background. The picture stays the same and the file usually grows, because PNG does not use JPEG compression.

avif-to-jpg.title: AVIF to JPG
avif-to-jpg.lede: Newer browsers save AVIF. If the other person sees a blank file, export JPG and send that. A blank preview here means this browser cannot decode AVIF.

png-to-webp.title: PNG to WebP
png-to-webp.lede: WebP is usually smaller than PNG and can keep a clear edge. Some old forms still want PNG. Open the download in the app that will receive it.

svg-to-png.title: SVG to PNG
svg-to-png.lede: SVG is drawn from shapes, so it can be made into a PNG at any size. Pick 2× or 4× for sharp icons and logos on high-density screens. Transparency stays in PNG.

clip.a5: There is no directory. Only people with the link can open a note, and it still expires.

watermark.q1: Does adding a watermark upload my photos?
watermark.a1: No. ID copies and photos stay in this tab. The canvas stamps the mark here. Closing the tab discards the files. Export also strips EXIF.
watermark.q2: What is the invisible watermark, and can it trace a leak?
watermark.a2: On export the tool hides the same text as the visible mark (or your own, such as “Bank A”), plus “cv.cm” and the export date, in the image brightness. It is on by default and can be switched off under Invisible watermark. If a copy turns up elsewhere, drop it on “Check an image for a hidden mark” to read it, even after the visible mark was painted over. It survives JPEG compression and resizing; cropping or rotation can break it. Short text holds up best. It is a lead, not legal proof.
watermark.q3: Can I watermark an ID or passport copy?
watermark.a3: Yes. Use For-use only so a tiled “for [org] use only” line covers the photo. Open Redact to black out the ID number too. Work stays in this tab. A watermark is a deterrent, not a legal guarantee. Some offices still want an unmarked copy.
watermark.a4: No. This tool only adds a mark. It will not erase watermarks from photos.
watermark.a5: PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF in. Export PNG, JPEG, or WebP. Text, a logo, or both. Add a batch and download one file or a ZIP.

collage.a2: Square, 4:5 portrait, 9:16 story, and 16:9 landscape are built in.
collage.q3: How many photos can I combine?
collage.a3: Layouts cover two to nine cells, including 2×2, 3×3, and split frames.
collage.a4: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, with quality control for the lossy formats.

days-between.a4: Yes, when the leap day sits in the gap. 28 February 2024 to 1 March 2024 is 2 days.
days-between.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

shift-date.q1: Can I add days to a date free online?
shift-date.a1: Yes. cv.cm shifts a civil date by a whole number of days in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
shift-date.q2: Can the number be negative or a fraction?
shift-date.a2: Negative numbers go backward. 1.5 is rejected. Only a whole number of days works.
shift-date.a3: 29 February 2024. In 2023 the same step lands on 1 March.
shift-date.q4: Does Friday plus 1 skip the weekend?
shift-date.a4: No. Friday plus 1 is Saturday. Add 3 to land on Monday.
shift-date.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

iso-week.q1: Can I find an ISO week number free online?
iso-week.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the ISO year, week, and weekday in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
iso-week.a2: Monday. Monday is 1 and Sunday is 7. A Sunday-start week is a different number.
iso-week.q3: Can January belong to the previous year?
iso-week.a3: Yes. 1 January 2021 is a Friday in 2020-W53. Week 1 is the week with the first Thursday.
iso-week.q4: Can late December belong to the next year?
iso-week.a4: Yes. 30 December 2024 is a Monday in 2025-W01.
iso-week.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

vat-price.q1: Can I add VAT to a price free online?
vat-price.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows net, tax, and gross in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
vat-price.a3: Net 100.00, tax 20.00, gross 120.00. The tax is not 24.00.
vat-price.q4: Does the page look up a country rate?
vat-price.a4: No. You type the rate. The three lines are arithmetic, not a tax filing, and they do not name a currency.
vat-price.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

percent-off.q1: Can I calculate a discount free online?
percent-off.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the sale price and the saving in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
percent-off.a2: Sale price 80.00, saving 20.00. That is not a 20% profit margin.
percent-off.a3: Yes. 120% off 100 is a sale price of -20.00. That is arithmetic, not a shop rule.
percent-off.q4: What does a negative percent do?
percent-off.a4: It raises the price. Minus 10% on 100 is 110.00. A tag that says 10% off uses 10.
percent-off.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it. The numbers have no currency.

encode-url.q1: Can I encode a URL free online?
encode-url.a1: Yes. cv.cm encodes and decodes the string in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
encode-url.a2: Encode writes %20. Decode turns %20 and + into a space.
encode-url.q3: Will slashes stay if I encode a whole address?
encode-url.a3: No. : and / become %3A and %2F. Encode a query value when the address itself must stay openable.
encode-url.a4: A % needs two hex digits after it. %zz and a lone % fail.
encode-url.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

calculate-age.q1: Can I calculate age free online?
calculate-age.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows years, months, days, and total days in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-age.q2: Does the year increase before the birthday?
calculate-age.a2: No. Born 15 March 2000, on 14 March 2026 the age is still 25 years, 11 months, and 27 days.
calculate-age.q3: What if the later date is before the birth date?
calculate-age.a3: The page fails. Age counts forward from the birth date.
calculate-age.q4: Is 29 February a real birth date?
calculate-age.a4: Yes. On 28 February 2025, a 29 February 2000 birth is 24 years, 11 months, and 30 days.
calculate-age.a5: No. Closing the tab discards them.

aspect-ratio.q1: Can I find an aspect ratio free online?
aspect-ratio.a1: Yes. cv.cm reduces width and height in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
aspect-ratio.a3: No. It only reduces the two numbers. The picture stays the size you typed.
aspect-ratio.a4: Each side is rounded to a whole pixel before the ratio.
aspect-ratio.a5: No. Closing the tab discards them.

calculate-bmi.q1: Can I calculate BMI free online?
calculate-bmi.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the BMI and the band in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-bmi.q2: What is the BMI for 70 kg and 170 cm?
calculate-bmi.q3: What if I type 1.70 for the height?
calculate-bmi.a3: The box is centimetres, so 1.70 means 1.70 cm. The BMI becomes 242214.5. Type 170.
calculate-bmi.a4: At 25. 18.5 is still Normal. Obesity starts at 30.
calculate-bmi.a5: No. Closing the tab discards them. The band is not a diagnosis.

split-tip.q1: Can I split a tip free online?
split-tip.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the tip, the total, and each share in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
split-tip.q2: What does each person pay on 100 at 20% for 4 people?
split-tip.a2: 30.00. The tip is 20.00 and the total is 120.00. 5.00 would be the tip split alone.
split-tip.a3: It counts as 2. The fraction is dropped. On 100 at 20%, each of those 2 pays 60.00.
split-tip.q4: What if the people count is below 1?
split-tip.a4: The page fails. 0.9 is not rounded up to 1.
split-tip.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it. The numbers have no currency.

loan-payment.q1: Can I calculate a loan payment free online?
loan-payment.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows the monthly payment, the interest, and the total in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
loan-payment.q2: What is the payment on 10000 at 12% for one year?
loan-payment.a2: 888.49 a month. Interest is 661.85 and the total is 10661.85. It is not 1200 of interest.
loan-payment.q3: What does a zero interest rate do?
loan-payment.a3: It divides the principal by the number of months. 12000 for one year is 1000.00 a month and 0.00 interest.
loan-payment.q4: Does 12 in the rate box mean 0.12?
loan-payment.a4: No. 12 means 12% a year. The monthly rate is that percent divided by 12. One year is 12 payments, not one.
loan-payment.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it. The page does not name a lender or a currency.

read-cron.q1: Can I read a cron expression free online?
read-cron.a1: Yes. cv.cm describes the five fields in this tab. Nothing is uploaded, and the job is not started.
read-cron.a2: Minute 0, hour 9, every day of the month, every month, and Monday.
read-cron.a3: 0 and 7. Monday is 1. The word MON fails.
read-cron.q4: Why did a six-field expression fail?
read-cron.a4: This page wants exactly five fields. There is no seconds field. Minute 60 also fails, because minutes stop at 59.
read-cron.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it. The page does not run the schedule.

mosaic-photo.q1: How do I pixelate part of a photo without an app?
mosaic-photo.a1: Open cv.cm mosaic, drop the photo, drag a box, and download. It runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.
mosaic-photo.q2: Is a mosaic enough to hide an ID number?
mosaic-photo.a2: Not always. Fine cells can leave digits readable. Use a black box for numbers and QR codes.
mosaic-photo.q3: Can someone remove the mosaic later?
mosaic-photo.a3: Not from your export. The covered pixels are replaced, not layered on top.
mosaic-photo.q4: Can I hide faces in a group photo?
mosaic-photo.a4: Yes. Draw one box per face. Each photo keeps its own boxes.
mosaic-photo.a5: No. Closing the tab discards it.

watermark-id-copy.q1: What should I write on an ID copy watermark?
watermark-id-copy.a1: Who it is for, what for, and the date, such as “For XX bank account opening only. Not valid otherwise. 2026-10-08”.
watermark-id-copy.q2: Should the watermark cover the photo?
watermark-id-copy.a2: Yes. Tile it so it crosses the portrait; a corner mark is easy to crop off.
watermark-id-copy.q3: Is a watermarked ID copy still valid?
watermark-id-copy.a3: A watermark deters misuse but is not a legal guarantee. Some counters require an unmarked copy; ask first.
watermark-id-copy.a4: No. It stays in this tab, and closing it discards the file. Export also removes EXIF.
watermark-id-copy.q5: Can I hide the ID number too?
watermark-id-copy.a5: Yes. Use Redact with a black box on the fields the receiver did not ask for.

find-bedtime.q1: Can I find a bedtime free online?
find-bedtime.a1: Yes. cv.cm counts the cycles in this tab. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
find-bedtime.a2: Five cycles of 90 minutes is 450 minutes, plus 14 minutes to fall asleep, counted back from 07:00.
find-bedtime.q3: How many hours should I sleep?
find-bedtime.a3: Five or six cycles, 7.5 to 9 hours, suit most adults. Three or four cycles are shown for nights when you have no choice.
find-bedtime.a4: No. Cycles range from about 70 to 120 minutes and change through the night. Treat the times as a starting point and adjust by how you feel.
find-bedtime.a5: No. It only lists times. Set the alarm on your phone or clock.

measure-body-fat.q1: Can I estimate body fat free online?
measure-body-fat.a1: Yes. cv.cm runs the U.S. Navy formula in this tab. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
measure-body-fat.a2: Height, neck and waist for men; height, neck, waist and hips for women. Weight is optional and only splits fat and lean mass.
measure-body-fat.a3: At the navel for men and at the narrowest point for women, tape level and snug.
measure-body-fat.q4: How accurate is the tape method?
measure-body-fat.a4: Within about 3 to 4 percentage points of a DEXA scan for most adults. It is better for tracking change than for one exact number.
measure-body-fat.q5: What is a healthy body fat?
measure-body-fat.a5: By the ACE ranges, fitness is 14–17% for men and 21–24% for women, and average is 18–24% and 25–31%. Ask a doctor about your own case.

check-contrast.q1: Can I check color contrast free online?
check-contrast.a1: Yes. cv.cm computes the WCAG ratio in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
check-contrast.q2: What ratio does normal text need?
check-contrast.a2: 4.5:1 for AA and 7:1 for AAA. Large text needs 3:1 and 4.5:1.
check-contrast.q4: Does the order of the colors matter?
check-contrast.a4: No. The ratio is the same either way. Swap only changes the preview.
check-contrast.a5: Its ratio on white is 4.48:1, just under 4.5:1. #767676 reaches 4.54:1 and passes.

calculate-pace.q1: Can I calculate running pace free online?
calculate-pace.a1: Yes. cv.cm does the math in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-pace.q2: What is 10 km in 55 minutes as pace?
calculate-pace.a2: 5:30 per km, 8:51 per mile, or 10.91 km/h.
calculate-pace.q3: How do I convert pace per km to per mile?
calculate-pace.a3: Multiply by 1.609. The page shows both at once.
calculate-pace.a4: They assume you hold the same pace. Most runners slow a little over longer distances, so treat them as a best case.
calculate-pace.a5: h:mm:ss or mm:ss, such as 1:45:29 or 55:00. Pace takes m:ss, such as 5:30.

calculate-final-grade.q1: Can I find the grade I need on a final free online?
calculate-final-grade.a1: Yes. cv.cm does the math in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-final-grade.a2: Needed = (wanted − current × (1 − weight)) ÷ weight, with the weight as a fraction such as 0.30.
calculate-final-grade.q3: What if I need more than 100%?
calculate-final-grade.a3: The target is out of reach on the final alone. Check the table for the highest letter you can still get.
calculate-final-grade.a4: Your weighted average on everything graded before the final, as your gradebook shows it.
calculate-final-grade.q5: Does the weight of the final matter a lot?
calculate-final-grade.a5: Yes. With 85% now and 90% wanted, a 30% final needs 101.7% but a 50% final needs only 95%.

calculate-tdee.q1: Can I calculate TDEE free online?
calculate-tdee.a1: Yes. cv.cm computes it in this tab. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
calculate-tdee.a2: Mifflin–St Jeor for BMR: 10 × kg + 6.25 × cm − 5 × age, plus 5 for men or minus 161 for women. TDEE is BMR × activity factor.
calculate-tdee.q3: How much should I cut to lose weight?
calculate-tdee.a3: The page subtracts 500 kcal, about 0.5 kg a week, but never below 1500 kcal for men or 1200 for women.
calculate-tdee.a4: Most desk workers who exercise 1–3 times a week are light; 3–5 times is moderate. When unsure, pick the lower one.
calculate-tdee.a5: No. It is an estimate for healthy adults. Ask a doctor or dietitian before a big change.

calculate-gpa.q1: Can I calculate GPA free online?
calculate-gpa.a1: Yes. cv.cm does the math in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-gpa.a2: Each grade becomes points, multiplied by the course credits. The sum of points is divided by the sum of credits.
calculate-gpa.a3: By default A+ is 4.0. Tick A+ = 4.3 if your school uses that scale.
calculate-gpa.a4: Usually not. Leave them out of the list.
calculate-gpa.q5: How do I get a cumulative GPA?
calculate-gpa.a5: Put every course from every term in one list. The result is weighted by credits across all of them.

use-pomodoro.q1: Can I use a Pomodoro timer free online?
use-pomodoro.a1: Yes. cv.cm runs it in this tab. Nothing is sent or stored.
use-pomodoro.a2: Work for 25 minutes, rest 5, and take a 15-minute break after four blocks. Each block is one pomodoro.
use-pomodoro.q3: Will it chime in a background tab?
use-pomodoro.a3: Yes, while the tab stays open. The timer follows the clock and the tab title shows the time left.
use-pomodoro.a4: Yes, from 1 to 180 minutes for each phase and 1 to 12 rounds, while the clock is stopped.
use-pomodoro.a5: No. Only finished focus blocks count toward the long break.

find-due-date.q1: Can I calculate a due date free online?
find-due-date.a1: Yes. cv.cm computes it in this tab. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
find-due-date.a2: Due date = first day of the last period + 280 days + (cycle length − 28).
find-due-date.q3: What if I only know the conception date?
find-due-date.a3: Pick Conception date; the due date is 266 days after it.
find-due-date.a4: Naegele's rule assumes ovulation on day 14 of a 28-day cycle. Enter your own cycle length and the tool shifts the dates.
find-due-date.a5: No. It is an estimate. An early ultrasound gives the most reliable date.

find-ideal-weight.q1: Can I find my ideal weight free online?
find-ideal-weight.a1: Yes. cv.cm computes it in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
find-ideal-weight.a2: None alone. Read the spread of the four as a range and check it against the BMI row.
find-ideal-weight.q3: What is the ideal weight for 170 cm?
find-ideal-weight.a3: About 65.2 to 66.7 kg for a man and 60.7 to 62.5 kg for a woman by the four formulas; the BMI 18.5–24.9 range is 53.5 to 72 kg.
find-ideal-weight.a4: Yes, down to 140 cm: the formulas extrapolate their per-inch step below 152.4 cm, so treat those results as rough.
find-ideal-weight.a5: No. The formulas come from dosing tables. A doctor or dietitian can set a personal target.

daily-water.q1: Can I calculate my water intake free online?
daily-water.a1: Yes. cv.cm computes it in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
daily-water.q2: How much water should a 70 kg person drink?
daily-water.a2: About 2.45 litres at rest, 2.8 litres with 30 minutes of exercise, and 3.3 litres in hot weather.
daily-water.a3: Yes. They are mostly water. Food also supplies roughly a fifth of daily fluid.
daily-water.q4: Is eight glasses a day right?
daily-water.a4: Eight 250 ml glasses is 2 litres, which fits a 57 kg person at rest. Heavier, active people need more; the calculator scales it.
daily-water.a5: No. Pregnancy, breastfeeding, kidney or heart conditions and some medicines change the need. Ask a doctor.

trip-fuel-cost.q1: Can I calculate fuel cost free online?
trip-fuel-cost.a1: Yes. cv.cm does the math in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
trip-fuel-cost.q2: How do I convert mpg to L/100 km?
trip-fuel-cost.a2: Divide 235.2 by the mpg: 30 mpg is 7.84 L/100 km. The tool does it when you pick mpg.
trip-fuel-cost.q3: What does 300 km cost at 7 L/100 km?
trip-fuel-cost.a3: 21 litres. At 1.60 a litre that is 33.60; the round trip is 67.20.
trip-fuel-cost.a4: None. The result is in whatever you type for the price.
trip-fuel-cost.q5: Why is my real cost higher?
trip-fuel-cost.a5: City traffic, air conditioning, roof racks and a loaded car raise consumption. Add about 10%.

estimate-reading-time.q1: Can I estimate reading time free online?
estimate-reading-time.a1: Yes. cv.cm counts it in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
estimate-reading-time.q2: How many words is a five-minute read?
estimate-reading-time.a2: About 1200 at the average 238 words a minute. Many sites use 200–250 wpm, so 1000–1250.
estimate-reading-time.q3: How many words is a five-minute speech?
estimate-reading-time.a3: About 650 at 130 words a minute. Slow, clear speakers use 550–600.
estimate-reading-time.a4: In characters: 300 a minute for reading and 180 for speaking. Mixed text counts Latin words and CJK characters together.
estimate-reading-time.a5: Yes, with and without spaces, for post and ad limits.

compare-text.q1: Can I compare two texts free online?
compare-text.a1: Yes. cv.cm diffs them in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
compare-text.a2: The left. Lines only on the right are added (+), lines only on the left are removed (−).
compare-text.a3: Yes. Tick Ignore extra spaces to skip whitespace-only changes.
compare-text.a4: The standard patch format with --- and +++ headers and @@ hunks, used by git and code reviews. Copy unified diff produces it.
compare-text.q5: Does it compare words inside a line?
compare-text.a5: No. It works line by line; a changed line shows as one removed and one added.

hash-text.q1: Can I hash a file free online without uploading it?
hash-text.a1: Yes. cv.cm reads the file in this tab with Web Crypto. Nothing is uploaded.
hash-text.a2: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512, in hex and Base64.
hash-text.q3: Why does my hash not match?
hash-text.a3: A different algorithm, an extra space or line break, or a different file. Check the algorithm first.
hash-text.a4: For checking a download against a listed checksum, yes. For passwords or signatures, no; use SHA-256 or better.
hash-text.q5: Can I verify a password hash here?
hash-text.a5: Only plain digests. Salted hashes such as bcrypt need their own tools.

generate-uuid.q1: Can I generate a UUID free online?
generate-uuid.a1: Yes. cv.cm makes them in this tab with Web Crypto. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
generate-uuid.a2: Version 4, random. The third group starts with 4.
generate-uuid.a3: In practice, no: 122 random bits give about 5.3 × 10^36 values.
generate-uuid.q4: Can I get them without hyphens?
generate-uuid.a4: Yes. Untick Hyphens for the 32-character form.
generate-uuid.a5: No. They exist only in this tab until you copy them.

calculate-work-hours.q1: Can I calculate hours worked free online?
calculate-work-hours.a1: Yes. cv.cm adds the shifts in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-work-hours.q2: How many hours is 9 to 5:30 with a 30-minute break?
calculate-work-hours.a2: 8 hours. 8.5 hours on the clock minus the unpaid break.
calculate-work-hours.q3: How do I convert 7 hours 45 minutes to decimal?
calculate-work-hours.a3: Divide the minutes by 60: 45 ÷ 60 = 0.75, so 7.75 hours.
calculate-work-hours.a4: Yes. An end time before the start runs past midnight: 22:00 to 06:00 is 8 hours.
calculate-work-hours.q5: Is the overtime rule right for my job?
calculate-work-hours.a5: The default is over 40 hours a week at 1.5×. Some places count daily overtime or use 2×; set the threshold and multiplier to your rules.

electricity-cost.q1: Can I calculate appliance electricity cost free online?
electricity-cost.a1: Yes. cv.cm does the math in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
electricity-cost.q2: How much does a 1000 W appliance cost per hour?
electricity-cost.a2: It uses 1 kWh an hour, so the cost equals your price per kWh, for example 0.15.
electricity-cost.q3: How do I convert amps to watts?
electricity-cost.a3: Multiply amps by volts: 5 A at 220 V is 1100 W, at 120 V it is 600 W.
electricity-cost.q4: Why is my fridge's real use lower?
electricity-cost.a4: The compressor runs only part of the time, often about a third, so the label watts overstate daily use.
electricity-cost.a5: Whatever you type for the price. The result is in the same currency.

find-fertile-window.q1: Can I calculate my ovulation day free online?
find-fertile-window.a1: Yes. cv.cm estimates it in this tab. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
find-fertile-window.q2: When do I ovulate with a 28-day cycle?
find-fertile-window.a2: Around day 14, counting the first day of your period as day 1.
find-fertile-window.q3: How long is the fertile window?
find-fertile-window.a3: About six days: the five days before ovulation plus ovulation day.
find-fertile-window.q4: Can I use this to avoid pregnancy?
find-fertile-window.a4: No. Calendar estimates are not reliable contraception. Use a proper method and ask a doctor.
find-fertile-window.q5: My cycle is irregular. What should I enter?
find-fertile-window.a5: The average of your last six cycles. Irregular cycles make the estimate less accurate; ovulation tests help.

calculate-macros.q1: Can I calculate macros free online?
calculate-macros.a1: Yes. cv.cm does the math in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-macros.q2: How many grams of protein is 30% of 2000 kcal?
calculate-macros.a3: A gram of fat has 9 kcal; protein and carbohydrate have 4.
calculate-macros.a4: Balanced suits most people. High protein helps keep muscle while losing weight; low carb suits people who prefer fewer carbs.
calculate-macros.q5: Where do I get my calories?
calculate-macros.a5: From the TDEE calculator, which estimates maintenance calories from age, size and activity.

calories-burned-exercise.q1: Can I calculate calories burned free online?
calories-burned-exercise.a1: Yes. cv.cm does the math in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
calories-burned-exercise.q2: How many calories does 30 minutes of running burn?
calories-burned-exercise.a2: About 343 kcal at 10 km/h for a 70 kg person; about 290 at 60 kg.
calories-burned-exercise.a3: The energy of an activity compared with sitting still. 1 MET is about 1 kcal per kg per hour.
calories-burned-exercise.a4: Within about 20% for most people. Fitness, effort and terrain change the real number.
calories-burned-exercise.q5: Where do the values come from?
calories-burned-exercise.a5: The 2011 Compendium of Physical Activities by Ainsworth and colleagues.

compound-interest.q1: Can I calculate compound interest free online?
compound-interest.a1: Yes. cv.cm does the math in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
compound-interest.q3: What is the difference from simple interest?
compound-interest.a3: Simple interest pays only on the original amount; compound interest also pays on interest already added.
compound-interest.q4: How long does it take to double?
compound-interest.a4: About 72 ÷ the rate in years: 14.4 years at 5%, 9 years at 8%.
compound-interest.a5: No. It shows one starting amount growing with no deposits, withdrawals or tax.

remove-photo-background.q1: Can I remove a photo background for free?
remove-photo-background.a1: Yes. cv.cm runs the AI model in your browser at no cost, with no sign-up and no watermark.
remove-photo-background.a2: No. The model downloads to your browser and the photos stay on your device.
remove-photo-background.q3: Why is the first run slow?
remove-photo-background.a3: The model downloads once. Later runs use the cached copy.
remove-photo-background.a4: PNG and WebP. JPG has no transparency, so it gets a white background.
remove-photo-background.q5: Can I do several photos at once?
remove-photo-background.a5: Yes. Drop several and use Download all (ZIP).

test-regex.q1: Can I test a regex free online?
test-regex.a1: Yes. cv.cm runs it in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
test-regex.a2: JavaScript, the same as browsers and Node.js. Most simple patterns work the same in Python and Java.
test-regex.q3: Why do I only get one match?
test-regex.a3: Turn on the g flag to find every match.
test-regex.q4: How do I use a capture group in the replacement?
test-regex.a4: $1 is the first group, $2 the second, $& the whole match.
test-regex.a5: No. Type only the pattern; flags are checkboxes.

pick-random-name.q1: Is there a free random name picker wheel?
pick-random-name.a1: Yes. cv.cm's wheel runs in your browser and draws with Web Crypto. Nothing is uploaded.
pick-random-name.a2: Yes. The winner is chosen at random before the animation, and every line has the same chance.
pick-random-name.q3: How do I stop the same name winning twice?
pick-random-name.a3: Tick “Remove the winner after each spin”; each winner leaves the list.
pick-random-name.q4: Can I give one option more chance?
pick-random-name.a4: Add it on more lines. Two lines out of six give it a 2 in 6 chance.
pick-random-name.q5: How many names can I add?
pick-random-name.a5: Up to 100 lines of up to 40 characters; long names are shortened on the wheel itself.

calculate-average.q1: Is there a free mean, median and mode calculator?
calculate-average.a1: Yes. cv.cm calculates them in your browser with standard deviation and variance. Nothing is uploaded.
calculate-average.q2: When should I use the median instead of the mean?
calculate-average.a2: When a few values are much larger or smaller than the rest, such as incomes or house prices.
calculate-average.q3: What is the difference between sample and population standard deviation?
calculate-average.a3: Sample divides by n − 1 and is used when the data is a sample; population divides by n and is used for the whole group.
calculate-average.a4: Then there is no mode; the tool shows None.
calculate-average.q5: Can I paste numbers with decimal commas?
calculate-average.a5: Yes. Set Decimal mark to 3,5; then commas are decimals and spaces, new lines or semicolons separate numbers.

use-metronome.q1: Is there a free online metronome?
use-metronome.a1: Yes. cv.cm's metronome runs in your browser from 20 to 300 BPM. Nothing is uploaded.
use-metronome.q2: How do I find the BPM of a song?
use-metronome.a2: Press Tap on the beat four or more times; the BPM follows the average of your taps.
use-metronome.q3: What BPM should I start at?
use-metronome.a3: The fastest tempo at which you can play the passage cleanly three times in a row.
use-metronome.a4: Pick 3 or 6 under Beats per bar; the first beat is accented.
use-metronome.a5: Check the volume slider, the device volume and the silent switch. Some browsers pause audio in background tabs.

test-keyboard.q1: Is there a free online keyboard tester?
test-keyboard.a1: Yes. cv.cm shows a full keyboard map in your browser. Nothing is recorded.
test-keyboard.q2: Why does a key not light up?
test-keyboard.a2: It may be broken, or it may be Fn or a system key that never reaches the browser.
test-keyboard.a3: How many keys the keyboard reports at once. Hold several keys and read the most held at once.
test-keyboard.q4: What is the difference between key and code?
test-keyboard.a4: key is the character produced and depends on the layout; code is the physical key position.
test-keyboard.a5: Yes. Ignore the number pad if your laptop has none.

find-zodiac-sign.q1: How do I find my zodiac sign free?
find-zodiac-sign.a1: Enter your birthday on cv.cm; it shows the star sign and Chinese zodiac in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
find-zodiac-sign.q2: Why is my Chinese zodiac animal different from the year I was born?
find-zodiac-sign.a2: If you were born before Lunar New Year, you belong to the previous lunar year.
find-zodiac-sign.a3: Leo, which runs from 23 July to 22 August.
find-zodiac-sign.q4: What is the Chinese zodiac for 2024?
find-zodiac-sign.a4: The wood Dragon (甲辰), from 10 February 2024 to 28 January 2025.
find-zodiac-sign.q5: Why do sign dates vary between sites?
find-zodiac-sign.a5: The Sun enters each sign at a slightly different time each year, so the first day can move by one.

test-click-speed.q1: What is a good CPS score?
test-click-speed.a1: 5–8 CPS is typical with one finger, 8–11 is fast, and above 11 usually takes jitter or butterfly clicking.
test-click-speed.q2: How long is a CPS test?
test-click-speed.a2: Usually 5 seconds. cv.cm also offers 1, 10, 30 and 60 seconds.
test-click-speed.a3: A light mouse with a short, crisp switch helps a little; technique matters more.
test-click-speed.q4: Is jitter clicking bad for you?
test-click-speed.a4: Long sessions can strain the wrist and forearm. Keep tries short and stop if it hurts.
test-click-speed.a5: No. Clicks are counted in the tab, and the best score is forgotten when you close it.

test-reaction-time.q1: What is a good reaction time?
test-reaction-time.a1: Around 200–300 ms is typical for a visual signal; under 200 ms is fast.
test-reaction-time.q2: Why is my score slower on my phone?
test-reaction-time.a2: Touch screens and some displays add latency. Compare results on the same device.
test-reaction-time.q3: Can I improve my reaction time?
test-reaction-time.a3: Sleep, warm-up and practice help a little; most of the gain is consistency, not raw speed.
test-reaction-time.a4: You clicked while the pad was red. That try does not count; click to retry it.
test-reaction-time.a5: No. The times are measured and kept in the tab.

generate-test-tone.q1: What frequency should I use to test speakers?
generate-test-tone.a1: Start with 440 Hz or 1000 Hz for level, then sweep from 50 Hz to 15 kHz.
generate-test-tone.q2: How do I test left and right channels?
generate-test-tone.a2: Pick Left or Right under Speaker and check that only that side plays.
generate-test-tone.a3: Hearing above 15–17 kHz fades with age, and many speakers cannot play it.
generate-test-tone.q4: Can a tone damage my speakers?
generate-test-tone.a4: At low volume, no. Very loud low or high tones can harm small speakers and your ears.
generate-test-tone.a5: Yes. It runs in your browser with no sign-up.

test-microphone.q1: How can I test my mic online?
test-microphone.a1: Open Mic test, press Start microphone, allow access and speak; the meter should move. Record 5 seconds to hear yourself.
test-microphone.q2: Why does my mic show no sound?
test-microphone.a2: It may be muted, the wrong device may be picked, or another app may be using it.
test-microphone.a3: No. It stays in the tab and is gone when you close it.
test-microphone.a4: Decibels relative to full scale: 0 is the loudest digital level, so speech levels are negative numbers.
test-microphone.q5: How do I allow a blocked microphone?
test-microphone.a5: Click the site icon next to the address bar, set Microphone to Allow and reload the page.

use-tally-counter.q1: Is there a free online tally counter?
use-tally-counter.a1: Yes. cv.cm's tally counter runs in your browser with no sign-up.
use-tally-counter.q2: Can I count with the keyboard?
use-tally-counter.a2: Yes: Space, ↑ or + adds and ↓ or − subtracts on the highlighted counter.
use-tally-counter.a3: Yes, in this browser's local storage. Private windows may forget them.
use-tally-counter.q4: How many counters can I have?
use-tally-counter.a4: Up to 12, each with its own name, plus a total.
use-tally-counter.a5: Yes. Set Step to the amount each press should add.

test-webcam.q1: What resolution should my webcam have?
test-webcam.a1: 720p is fine for most calls; 1080p looks sharper when the app sends it. A 4K webcam mostly helps with cropping and zoom.
test-webcam.a2: Clean the lens, give it light from the front, and check that the camera has focused (fixed-focus webcams are sharp from about 50 cm).
test-webcam.a3: Low light drops the frame rate; a busy USB hub or an old USB 2.0 port can limit 1080p. Try more light, 720p or another port.
test-webcam.a4: Yes. The video stays in your browser tab and photos are made on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
test-webcam.a5: So moving left moves left on screen, like a mirror. Others see you unmirrored; untick Mirror the preview to see that view.

test-gamepad.a1: A stick that reports movement when nobody touches it, usually because the sensor inside has worn or picked up dirt.
test-gamepad.q2: How do I read drift in the tester?
test-gamepad.a2: Let go of the stick and read the distance under it: near 0.00 is centred, above 0.05 slight drift, 0.15 or more drift.
test-gamepad.q3: Why does my controller not show up?
test-gamepad.a3: Press a button after connecting; browsers hide controllers until then. Also close Steam's input layer or other remapping tools if they grab it.
test-gamepad.q4: Does it work with Switch Joy-Con?
test-gamepad.a4: Usually as two separate non-standard pads with numbered buttons. A Switch Pro controller shows the standard layout in most browsers.
test-gamepad.a5: No. The tester reads the controller in your browser tab with the Gamepad API.

check-dead-pixels.q1: What is the difference between a dead and a stuck pixel?
check-dead-pixels.a1: A dead pixel gets no power and stays black. A stuck pixel has one or two subpixels always on, so it shows a fixed colour.
check-dead-pixels.q2: Can I fix a stuck pixel?
check-dead-pixels.a2: Sometimes it comes back after hours of normal use. Fast-flashing fixer videos exist, but they can trigger seizures and often do not help, so this test does not flash.
check-dead-pixels.q3: How many dead pixels are acceptable?
check-dead-pixels.a3: It depends on the maker's pixel policy: many allow a few on a new monitor; some promise zero. Check the warranty terms.
check-dead-pixels.q4: Does it work on OLED screens?
check-dead-pixels.a4: Yes. On OLED, also look at gray and white for burn-in: faint shapes left from static images.
check-dead-pixels.a5: No. The test only draws colours in your browser.

check-refresh-rate.a1: It is accurate to the rate the browser draws at, which is the screen's rate unless something caps it. Small differences (143.9 instead of 144) are normal.
check-refresh-rate.q2: Why does my 144 Hz monitor show 60 Hz?
check-refresh-rate.a2: The system setting is still 60 Hz, the cable or port cannot carry more, battery saver is on, or the window is on another 60 Hz screen.
check-refresh-rate.a3: The time between two frames in milliseconds: 1000 divided by the refresh rate.
check-refresh-rate.q4: Does a higher refresh rate matter outside games?
check-refresh-rate.a4: Scrolling, cursor movement and video look smoother, and fast motion is easier to follow.
check-refresh-rate.a5: No. The frames are counted in your browser tab.

test-touch-screen.q1: What is a touch screen dead zone?
test-touch-screen.a1: An area where touches are not detected, often from a damaged digitiser or a cracked screen.
test-touch-screen.q2: How many touch points does my phone support?
test-touch-screen.a2: Most phones and tablets track 5–10 fingers. Put down as many as you can and read Most at once.
test-touch-screen.q3: Why is my touch screen jumpy?
test-touch-screen.a3: Moisture, a screen protector or a charger without a good ground are common causes. Test again without them.
test-touch-screen.q4: Can I test it with a mouse?
test-touch-screen.a4: Yes, hold the left button and draw, but a mouse cannot test multi-touch or dead zones on the screen itself.
test-touch-screen.a5: No. Touches are drawn in your browser tab only.

use-scientific-calculator.a1: The calculator is in RAD mode, so it reads 30 as 30 radians. Switch to DEG and sin(30) is 0.5.
use-scientific-calculator.q2: What is the difference between log and ln?
use-scientific-calculator.a2: log is base 10, so log(1000) is 3. ln is base e (about 2.718), so ln(e) is 1. For base 2 you can type log2(8), which is 3.
use-scientific-calculator.a3: Here % always means divide by 100, so 10% is 0.1 and 200 + 0.1 is 200.1. To add 10% to 200, write 200 × 1.1 for 220.
use-scientific-calculator.a4: The power is worked out before the minus sign, so it reads as −(2²). Write (−2)^2 to get 4.
use-scientific-calculator.q5: Why do I get Too large or Not defined?
use-scientific-calculator.a5: Too large means the answer is beyond what the calculator can hold: 170! works, 171! does not. Not defined means the sum has no answer, such as dividing by 0.

use-online-notepad.a1: Yes. It stays in your browser's storage on this device and is not sent to cv.cm. Anyone using this browser profile can open the page and read it, so avoid it on shared computers.
use-online-notepad.q2: Will I lose my note if I close the tab?
use-online-notepad.a2: No. It comes back when you open the page in the same browser. It is lost if you clear site data for cv.cm, which is why downloading a copy is worth it.
use-online-notepad.q3: Can I get my note on another device?
use-online-notepad.a3: Not automatically, as nothing is stored online. Download the .txt and open it on the other device with Open file.
use-online-notepad.q4: Does it work in a private window?
use-online-notepad.a4: You can write there, but private windows discard storage when closed, and some block it completely. Download the note before you close the window.
use-online-notepad.q5: How long can a note be?
use-online-notepad.a5: Up to 1,000,000 characters, and files you open can be up to 1 MB. Very long notes can feel slow in the text box.

preview-markdown.a1: A way to format plain text with simple marks such as # for headings and ** for bold. GitHub, Reddit, Discord and many note apps read it.
preview-markdown.q2: Which Markdown does this preview support?
preview-markdown.a2: CommonMark's common syntax plus GitHub tables, task lists, strikethrough and bare links. Other sites may render the extras a little differently.
preview-markdown.q3: Why does my HTML show as text?
preview-markdown.a3: Raw HTML is kept as text on purpose, so a pasted document cannot run code in the page or in the HTML you copy. Use the Markdown marks instead.
preview-markdown.q4: How do I add a line break?
preview-markdown.a4: End the line with two spaces for a line break, or leave a blank line to start a new paragraph. A single line break on its own may be joined up when rendered.
preview-markdown.a5: No. It is rendered in your browser tab and kept in this browser. Up to 200,000 characters can be kept.

make-css-gradient.q1: Why does my gradient not show on the page?
make-css-gradient.a1: The element probably has no height. A gradient fills the element's box, so an empty block is 0 high. Give it a height or some content; for a full page, set html and body to height 100%.
make-css-gradient.q2: Why are there two background lines in the CSS?
make-css-gradient.a2: The first is a solid colour, and the second is the gradient. A browser that cannot draw the gradient ignores that line and keeps the colour.
make-css-gradient.a3: Both work, as a gradient counts as an image. background is shorter and also resets other background settings, so use background-image if you are layering it over other backgrounds.
make-css-gradient.q4: How do I make a hard colour stripe?
make-css-gradient.a4: Put two colours at the same position, for example both at 50%. There is then no room to blend, so the colour changes at a sharp line.
make-css-gradient.q5: Why does the PNG look banded?
make-css-gradient.a5: Very wide gradients between similar colours can show faint steps, because a PNG stores 256 levels per colour channel. Use colours further apart, or add a slight texture in an image editor.

make-fancy-text.q1: Why do I see empty boxes?
make-fancy-text.a1: The device has no font containing that symbol. Older phones and computers are the most likely to show boxes. Try a more common style, such as Bold.
make-fancy-text.q2: Does it work with Chinese or accented letters?
make-fancy-text.a2: Letter styles do not: Unicode has styled forms for A–Z, a–z and digits, not for those characters, so they stay as you typed them. Strikethrough and Underline do work, as they add a line to each character.
make-fancy-text.q3: Can I use it for my Instagram or TikTok name?
make-fancy-text.a3: Display names and bios usually accept it, though it depends on the app and can change. Usernames normally allow only plain letters, digits and a few marks.
make-fancy-text.q4: Is it bad for screen readers?
make-fancy-text.a4: It can be. Screen readers may skip the symbols or read each one by its full name, which makes a sentence very hard to follow. Leave important information plain.
make-fancy-text.q5: Do I need to install a font?
make-fancy-text.a5: No. You are copying characters, not a font, so the text looks styled wherever the reader's device has the symbols.

flip-coin.q1: Is an online coin flip really fair?
flip-coin.a1: Yes. Each flip takes one bit from your browser's secure random generator, so both faces are equally likely. Nothing is sent to a server, so the result is made on your device.
flip-coin.q2: Are heads more likely after a run of tails?
flip-coin.a2: No. Believing so is called the gambler's fallacy. Each flip is independent of the ones before, so the chance stays at 50%.
flip-coin.q3: How long a streak is normal?
flip-coin.a3: Longer than most people guess. In 100 flips, a run of 6 or more of the same face is usual, and that does not mean anything is wrong.
flip-coin.q4: Why did I not get exactly 500 out of 1,000?
flip-coin.a4: Exactly half is actually rare, at about 2.5% for 1,000 coins. Most results fall between 470 and 530 heads, and the share gets closer to 50% as the number of flips grows.
flip-coin.q5: Can I use it for something serious?
flip-coin.a5: It is fair for everyday decisions, games and teaching. If a draw has legal or money rules, follow the official process, since it may need a witness or an audit.

tune-guitar.q1: Why does the tuner show a different note from the string?
tune-guitar.a1: Auto follows the closest string, so a string far from its target can read as its neighbour, and an overtone can do the same. Tap the string you want to lock onto it, then pluck softly and tune up gradually.
tune-guitar.q2: Why does the reading jump around?
tune-guitar.a2: Noise and other ringing strings confuse the pitch reading. Mute the other strings with your hand, pluck with the soft part of your thumb, and read it just after the first attack.
tune-guitar.a3: It is the standard pitch of the note A above middle C. Leave Reference A4 at 440 unless you are matching a piano or a recording tuned to something else.
tune-guitar.q4: Can I tune without a microphone?
tune-guitar.a4: Yes. Tap the string you want, then press Play reference to hear its note and match the string by ear. Listen for the slow beats between the two sounds, and turn the peg until they stop.
tune-guitar.a5: Every time you play. Check it again after you put on new strings or move between hot and cold rooms, because both change the tension in the strings.

find-factors.q1: What is the difference between factors and prime factors?
find-factors.a1: Factors are all the numbers that divide it exactly: 12 has 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12. Prime factors are the primes that multiply to make it: 12 = 2² × 3.
find-factors.a2: No. A prime has exactly two different factors, 1 and itself, and 1 has only one. Keeping 1 out means every number has just one prime factorization.
find-factors.q3: How many factors does a prime number have?
find-factors.a3: Exactly two: 1 and itself. A number with an odd count of factors is always a perfect square, as its square root pairs with itself.
find-factors.q4: Why stop at the square root?
find-factors.a4: Factors come in pairs, one at or below the square root and one at or above it. If nothing up to the square root divides the number, it is prime.
find-factors.q5: How large a number can the calculator handle?
find-factors.a5: Up to 18 digits, with exact whole-number maths. If the number has more than 1,000 factors, the first 1,000 are listed, and the counts stay exact.

find-lcm-gcf.q1: What is the difference between GCF, GCD and HCF?
find-lcm-gcf.a1: None. Greatest common factor, greatest common divisor and highest common factor are three names for the same number.
find-lcm-gcf.q2: What are the LCM and GCF of 12 and 18?
find-lcm-gcf.a2: The GCF is 6 and the LCM is 36. Check: 6 × 36 = 216, which is 12 × 18.
find-lcm-gcf.q3: How does the LCM help me add fractions?
find-lcm-gcf.a3: It gives the smallest shared denominator. For 1/12 + 1/18, use 36: 3/36 + 2/36 = 5/36.
find-lcm-gcf.a4: Two numbers are coprime when their GCF is 1, such as 8 and 15. Neither has to be prime; they just share no prime factor.
find-lcm-gcf.q5: Why did 1,500 turn into two numbers?
find-lcm-gcf.a5: A comma separates numbers here, so 1,500 reads as 1 and 500. Type 1500 without the separator.

use-emulator.a1: No. The file is read in this tab and handed to the emulator on the page. Only the emulator itself is downloaded.
use-emulator.q2: Is it legal to play ROMs?
use-emulator.a2: It depends on the game and on where you live. Homebrew that its author released freely is fine. Rules for copies of commercial games differ by country, so check yours.
use-emulator.q3: Which file should I choose from a zip?
use-emulator.a3: Choose the zip itself. The tool looks inside it for a ROM and the emulator opens it. If the zip holds a .bin, choose the console yourself.
use-emulator.q4: Can I play PlayStation or Nintendo DS games?
use-emulator.a4: No. This tool covers FC / NES, SFC / SNES, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance and Mega Drive / Genesis.
use-emulator.a5: The floppy disk icon downloads a .state file to your device. To continue later, open the same ROM and load that file with the folder icon. Saves made in the game's own menu may stay in this browser until site data is cleared, so keep a .state file for anything you care about.

open-swf-file.q1: Do I need Adobe Flash Player?
open-swf-file.a1: No. Ruffle runs the file in the page, so there is nothing to install. This page is not from Adobe.
open-swf-file.a2: No. The file stays in this tab and is not sent to a server.
open-swf-file.a3: Browsers may block audio that plays by itself. If you hear nothing, click the picture once.
open-swf-file.q4: Why does it stop on the loading screen?
open-swf-file.a4: The game probably needs more files or its old website. This page blocks network access, so it cannot fetch them.
open-swf-file.q5: Can I open a SWF on a phone?
open-swf-file.a5: Yes. A tap counts as a click. Games that need a keyboard are easier on a computer.

calculate-mortgage.q1: What is the formula for a monthly mortgage payment?
calculate-mortgage.a1: M = P × r × (1 + r)ⁿ ÷ ((1 + r)ⁿ − 1), where P is the loan, r the yearly rate ÷ 12 and n the number of months. 320,000 at 6.5% for 30 years gives 2,022.62.
calculate-mortgage.q2: Is equal principal better than equal payments?
calculate-mortgage.a2: It costs less interest because the loan shrinks faster, but the first payments are higher. Equal payments are easier to budget. Choose the one your income can carry at the start.
calculate-mortgage.q3: How much does a bigger down payment help?
calculate-mortgage.a3: Every unit of down payment is a unit you do not borrow, so the payment and the interest fall in the same proportion. In the US, 20% down usually also avoids mortgage insurance.
calculate-mortgage.q4: Why is so much of the first payment interest?
calculate-mortgage.a4: Interest is charged on the balance still owed, which is highest at the start. As the balance falls, more of the same payment goes to the loan.
calculate-mortgage.q5: Does the result match what my bank will charge?
calculate-mortgage.a5: For the same loan, rate and term, the principal and interest should match to the cent or within rounding. Bank quotes may add fees, tax, insurance or a different rate type.

solve-quadratic.a1: x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) ÷ 2a. It solves every equation of the form ax² + bx + c = 0 with a not 0.
solve-quadratic.q2: What if the discriminant is negative?
solve-quadratic.a2: There are no real roots and the graph does not cross the x-axis. The roots are complex: for x² + 2x + 5 = 0 they are −1 ± 2i.
solve-quadratic.a3: When the discriminant is a perfect square and a, b and c are whole numbers, the roots are fractions and the equation factors. x² − 3x + 2 = (x − 1)(x − 2).
solve-quadratic.q4: How do I find the vertex?
solve-quadratic.a4: The vertex is at x = −b ÷ 2a. Put that x back in the equation for y. For x² − 3x + 2 it is (1.5, −0.25).
solve-quadratic.q5: How do I check my answer?
solve-quadratic.a5: Put each root back into ax² + bx + c. If the result is 0 (or very close, for rounded decimals), the root is right.

make-random-teams.q1: Is a random team generator really fair?
make-random-teams.a1: Yes, if every possible split is equally likely and no one redraws until they like it. This one shuffles with Web Crypto and deals the names round-robin.
make-random-teams.q2: What if the names don't divide evenly?
make-random-teams.a2: Teams differ by at most one person. 10 names into 3 teams gives 4, 3 and 3, and the team with 4 is picked at random.
make-random-teams.q3: How many names can I use?
make-random-teams.a3: Up to 500 names and 50 teams. There can be no more teams than names.
make-random-teams.q4: Can I keep some people together or apart?
make-random-teams.a4: Not in the draw itself. Put a pair on one line (for example "Ann & Ben") to keep them together as one entry.
make-random-teams.a5: No. They stay in this tab and are not uploaded or saved.

check-screen-resolution.q1: How do I find my screen resolution on Windows or Mac?
check-screen-resolution.a1: In Windows, Settings → System → Display shows the same figure as the big number here. On a Mac, System Settings → Displays shows the "looks like" size, which is the CSS size on this page; the big number is the real pixels behind it.
check-screen-resolution.q2: Why does a website say my screen is smaller than it is?
check-screen-resolution.a2: Websites see CSS pixels. With display scaling above 100% there are fewer CSS pixels than real ones. Multiply by the device pixel ratio to get the real resolution.
check-screen-resolution.a3: Phones have a pixel ratio of 2 to 3 or more, so a phone that reports 390 × 844 CSS pixels at ratio 3 has 1170 × 2532 real pixels.
check-screen-resolution.q4: Is a bigger viewport the same as a bigger screen?
check-screen-resolution.a4: No. The viewport is only the browser window's page area. It is smaller than the screen when the window is not full screen or toolbars take space.
check-screen-resolution.q5: Why don't the values match with two monitors?
check-screen-resolution.a5: The page reads the screen the browser window is on. Move the window to the other monitor and the values update.

set-online-alarm.q1: Does an online alarm work when the tab is in the background?
set-online-alarm.a1: Yes, as long as the tab is open and the computer is awake. The ring is scheduled in the audio engine, so background tab throttling does not delay it.
set-online-alarm.q2: Will it ring if my laptop goes to sleep?
set-online-alarm.a2: No. A sleeping computer runs no web pages. Change the power settings or keep the laptop plugged in and awake.
set-online-alarm.a3: One per tab. Open the page in another tab for a second alarm.
set-online-alarm.q4: Why did I hear nothing when it rang?
set-online-alarm.a4: The tab or system was muted, or the phone was locked or in silent mode. Use Test sound before you rely on it.
set-online-alarm.q5: Is the alarm saved if I reload?
set-online-alarm.a5: No. Reloading or closing the tab clears it. Nothing is stored or uploaded.

play-white-noise.q1: Is white noise or brown noise better for sleep?
play-white-noise.a1: It depends on the person. Brown and pink noise have less treble, so many find them softer; white noise masks high-pitched sounds better. Try each for a few nights.
play-white-noise.q2: How loud should white noise be?
play-white-noise.a2: Just loud enough to cover background sounds, below a normal conversation (about 60 dB). For babies, keep it lower and the speaker away from the cot.
play-white-noise.q3: Can I play it all night?
play-white-noise.a3: Yes, choose Off (play until stopped) or an 8 h timer. Use a low volume if it plays for many hours.
play-white-noise.q4: Why does the sound stop when my phone locks?
play-white-noise.a4: Some mobile browsers pause web audio in the background. Keep the screen on, or use the page on a computer or tablet.
play-white-noise.a5: No. The noise is calculated in the page, so nothing is downloaded and nothing is uploaded.

measure-decibels.q1: Can a phone measure decibels accurately?
measure-decibels.a1: To within a few dB after calibration, for levels between about 35 and 100 dB. Below that the microphone's own noise shows; above it the microphone may clip.
measure-decibels.q2: What is the difference between dB and dB(A)?
measure-decibels.a2: dB(A) is weighted like human hearing, turning down low rumbles and very high tones. Most noise limits use dB(A).
measure-decibels.a3: The equivalent continuous level: the steady level with the same total sound energy as the changing noise you measured.
measure-decibels.q4: Why does the reading change with distance?
measure-decibels.a4: Sound spreads out: in open space each doubling of distance from a small source lowers the level by about 6 dB.
measure-decibels.a5: No. The microphone signal is analysed in the tab and discarded. Nothing is stored or uploaded.

record-voice-online.q1: Why is my recording a WebM file?
record-voice-online.a1: Chrome, Edge and Firefox record WebM with the Opus codec. It plays in browsers and VLC. Use Download WAV for apps that do not open it.
record-voice-online.q2: Can I record for an hour?
record-voice-online.a2: Yes, a take can be up to 120 minutes. Download long takes promptly, as they use the tab's memory.
record-voice-online.q3: How do I convert the recording to MP3?
record-voice-online.a3: Download WAV, then convert it with an audio editor or converter. WAV keeps full quality for the conversion.
record-voice-online.q4: Why does my voice sound quiet or muffled?
record-voice-online.a4: Move closer to the microphone, check that the right one is selected, and do not cover it. Voice cleanup can sound muffled with music; turn it off for that.
record-voice-online.a5: No. They stay in the tab until you download them. Nothing is uploaded.

record-screen-online.q1: Why is there no sound in my screen recording?
record-screen-online.a1: Tick System or tab audio before starting, then share a tab and keep its audio option on. Sound of the entire screen is recorded only in Chrome and Edge on Windows and ChromeOS, and Firefox and Safari record no shared sound; add Microphone for your voice.
record-screen-online.q2: Can I record a video call?
record-screen-online.a2: Yes. Share the call's tab or window, tick Microphone for your voice and System or tab audio for the others. Tell the people in the call that you are recording.
record-screen-online.q3: How long can a recording be?
record-screen-online.a3: Up to 60 minutes each. At High quality an hour is about 3.6 GB, so make sure you have space.
record-screen-online.q4: Will the video have a watermark?
record-screen-online.a4: No. The file is exactly what was recorded.
record-screen-online.a5: No. It is recorded in the tab and saved only when you press Download.

solve-triangle.q1: What is the minimum I need to solve a triangle?
solve-triangle.a1: Three values including at least one side, or two values for a right triangle. Three angles give the shape but not the size.
solve-triangle.q2: When do I use the law of sines or cosines?
solve-triangle.a2: Use cosines with three sides or two sides and the angle between them. Use sines when you know a side and the angle opposite it.
solve-triangle.q3: How do I find the hypotenuse?
solve-triangle.a3: c = √(a² + b²). For legs 3 and 4 the hypotenuse is 5.
solve-triangle.q4: Why can't my values make a triangle?
solve-triangle.a4: Each side must be shorter than the other two together, and the angles must add up to less than 180° before the third is added.
solve-triangle.a5: The calculator uses degrees. Multiply radians by 180/π (about 57.2958) to convert.

make-gif.q1: How many frames can a GIF have?
make-gif.a1: The format has no real limit; this maker stops at 300 frames to keep the tab responsive. That is 30 seconds at 10 frames per second.
make-gif.q2: What frame delay should I use?
make-gif.a2: 100–200 ms for motion, 500 ms to 1 s for a slideshow. Browsers slow delays under 20 ms, so very fast GIFs play slower than set.
make-gif.a3: No. GIF is pictures only. Use a video file if sound matters.
make-gif.q4: How do I make a GIF loop?
make-gif.a4: Choose Loop forever under Repeat. Play once makes it stop on the last frame.
make-gif.a5: Yes. It is free, adds no watermark and works in the page, so your pictures and videos are not uploaded.

split-image.q1: What size should each tile be for Instagram?
split-image.a1: 1080 × 1440 px for the 3:4 posts the profile grid shows, so a 3 × 3 grid wants a picture at least 3240 × 4320 px. Square carousel slides are 1080 × 1080.
split-image.q2: Why do my tiles differ by one pixel?
split-image.a2: When the picture's size does not divide by the number of rows or columns, some tiles get one extra pixel so nothing is lost.
split-image.q3: Can I split a picture into two halves?
split-image.a3: Yes: 1 × 2 cuts it left and right, 2 × 1 top and bottom.
split-image.q4: Does it work for printing posters?
split-image.a4: Yes. Set Rows and Columns (for example 2 and 3), then choose Whole picture under Tile shape, and print each tile on its own sheet.
split-image.a5: No. The tiles are cut in your browser.

calculate-area.q1: What is the difference between area and perimeter?
calculate-area.a1: Area is the surface inside the shape (m²). Perimeter is the length around it (m): what you need for skirting or a fence.
