alarm.missed: The alarm rang for 10 minutes and stopped.
alarm.invalid: Pick a time for the alarm.
alarm.noAudio: This browser blocks sound, so the alarm can only show on screen.

whiteNoise.title: White noise generator
whiteNoise.privacyNote: The noise is made in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
whiteNoise.about_white: Equal energy at every frequency: a bright hiss, like a detuned radio.
whiteNoise.about_pink: Softer highs (−3 dB per octave): steady rain or wind.
whiteNoise.about_brown: Deep and rumbling (−6 dB per octave): distant surf or a waterfall.
whiteNoise.about_green: Centred on the mid range around 500 Hz: a calm, natural hum.
whiteNoise.hint: Start quiet and raise the volume slowly. Keep the tab open; it can be in the background.
whiteNoise.noAudio: This browser blocks sound from web pages.

decibelMeter.title: Decibel meter
decibelMeter.privacyNote: Measured in this tab. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
decibelMeter.calibrationHint: Add or subtract dB until the reading matches a real sound level meter. Saved in this browser.
decibelMeter.band_veryLoud: Very loud: long exposure can harm hearing
decibelMeter.hint: An estimate from your device's microphone, not a certified meter. Readings above about 100 dB may be capped by the microphone.
decibelMeter.idle: Press Start and allow the microphone.
decibelMeter.noWeighting: Measuring. This browser cannot apply A-weighting, so the reading is unweighted.
decibelMeter.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in the address bar and press Start again.
decibelMeter.busy: The microphone is in use by another app.
decibelMeter.failed: The microphone could not be started.
decibelMeter.unsupported: This browser cannot use the microphone.
decibelMeter.insecure: The microphone needs a secure (https) page.

voiceRecorder.title: Voice recorder
voiceRecorder.privacyNote: Recorded in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
voiceRecorder.hint: Up to {n} minutes per take. Recordings stay in this tab until you download them.
voiceRecorder.idle: Press Record and allow the microphone.
voiceRecorder.saved: Saved a {time} recording. Play it or download it below.
voiceRecorder.wavFailed: This recording could not be converted to WAV. Download the original instead.
voiceRecorder.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in the address bar and press Record again.
voiceRecorder.busy: The microphone is in use by another app.

screenRecorder.title: Screen recorder
screenRecorder.privacyNote: Recorded in this tab. Nothing is uploaded, no watermark.
screenRecorder.hint: Up to {n} minutes per recording. To record a tab's sound, share that tab and tick its audio box.
screenRecorder.support: Works in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on a computer. Phones and tablets cannot record the screen from a web page; use their built-in screen recording.
screenRecorder.idle: Press Start recording and choose what to share.
screenRecorder.choose: Choose a screen, window or tab, then press Share.
screenRecorder.saved: Saved a {time} recording. Check it and download it.
screenRecorder.saveFirst: Download or discard the last recording before starting a new one.
screenRecorder.noSystemAudio: Recording without system sound: the browser did not share audio for this choice.
screenRecorder.micDenied: Recording without the microphone: access was blocked.
screenRecorder.noMix: Recording without the microphone: the browser could not mix it with the shared sound.
screenRecorder.busy: The screen could not be captured. Close other recording apps and try again.
screenRecorder.noCapture: This browser cannot record the screen. Use Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a computer.
screenRecorder.insecure: Screen recording needs a secure (https) page.

triangle.title: Triangle calculator
triangle.privacyNote: Solved in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
triangle.needThree: Enter any three values, at least one of them a side.
triangle.needRight: Enter any two values, at least one of them a side.
triangle.hint: Side a is opposite angle A, b opposite B, c opposite C. Use one unit for all sides.
triangle.twoSolutions: These values fit two triangles. Both are shown.
triangle.case_sss: Three sides (SSS): find each angle with the law of cosines.
triangle.case_sas: Two sides and the angle between them (SAS): the law of cosines gives the third side.
triangle.case_ssa: Two sides and an angle not between them (SSA): the law of sines gives the other angles.
triangle.case_asa: Two angles and the side between them (ASA): the law of sines gives the other sides.
triangle.case_aas: Two angles and a side (AAS): the law of sines gives the other sides.
triangle.case_right: Right triangle: Pythagoras and sine/cosine give the rest.
triangle.stepCosines: Third side: c² = a² + b² − 2ab · cos C (with the two known sides and the angle between them).
triangle.stepAmbiguous: sin B has two angles below 180°: one acute, one obtuse. Both leave room for C, so there are two triangles.
triangle.drawingLabel: Triangle with sides a = {a}, b = {b}, c = {c}
triangle.err_needThree: Enter at least three values (two for a right triangle).
triangle.err_needSide: Angles alone fix the shape but not the size: enter at least one side.
triangle.err_tooMany: Enter only three values; clear the others.
triangle.err_positive: Sides and angles must be numbers above 0.
triangle.err_angleRange: Each angle must be below 180° (below 90° besides the right angle).
triangle.err_angleSum: The angles add up to 180° or more, so they cannot form a triangle.
triangle.err_inequality: These sides cannot form a triangle: each side must be shorter than the other two together.
triangle.err_noTriangle: No triangle fits these values: the side opposite the angle is too short.
triangle.err_hypotenuse: The hypotenuse c must be the longest side.
triangle.err_rightTooMany: In a right triangle C is 90°: enter only two other values.

gifMaker.title: GIF maker
gifMaker.privacyNote: Make an animated GIF from pictures or a short video. Everything happens in this tab; nothing is uploaded.
gifMaker.dropHint: or click to choose; you can also paste
gifMaker.dropTypes: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF · MP4, WebM
gifMaker.empty: No frames yet. Each picture becomes one frame.
gifMaker.clipInfo: {s} s video · {n} frames with these settings
gifMaker.hint: Pictures play in the order listed. A video is sampled from Start to End at the frame rate.
gifMaker.needFrames: Add pictures or a video first.
gifMaker.tooMany: A GIF here can have at most {max} frames. Use fewer pictures, a shorter clip or a lower frame rate.
gifMaker.errorRange: End must be after Start, inside the video.
gifMaker.errorDecode: Some files could not be read as pictures.
gifMaker.errorVideo: This browser cannot play that video. Try an MP4 (H.264) or WebM file.

imageSplitter.title: Image splitter
imageSplitter.privacyNote: Cut a picture into a grid of tiles for an Instagram grid, a carousel or printing. Nothing is uploaded.
imageSplitter.dropHint: or click to choose; you can also paste
imageSplitter.dropTypes: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC where supported
imageSplitter.empty: Add a picture to see the grid.
imageSplitter.hint: The dimmed edges are trimmed to give every tile the chosen shape. Tiles are never resized.
imageSplitter.info: {n} tiles of {w} × {h} px from a {W} × {H} px picture.
imageSplitter.infoUneven: {n} tiles of about {w} × {h} px from a {W} × {H} px picture (the size does not divide evenly, so some are 1 px larger).
imageSplitter.done: {n} tiles ready. Tap a tile to save it.
imageSplitter.errorDecode: That file could not be read as a picture.
imageSplitter.tooFine: The grid is finer than the picture ({W} × {H} px): every tile needs at least 1 px. Use fewer rows or columns.

area.title: Area calculator
area.privacyNote: Area and perimeter of 12 shapes, with the formula, the working and every common unit.
area.noSecond: The perimeter is not fixed by these inputs: shapes with the same base and height can have different sides.
area.approx: ≈ The ellipse perimeter uses Ramanujan's approximation (within 0.04%).
area.err_missing: Fill in every size for this shape.
area.err_count: A regular polygon needs a whole number of sides from 3 to 1,000.
area.err_angle: The angle can be at most 360°.
area.err_triangle: These sides do not make a triangle: the two shorter ones must add up to more than the longest.
area.err_annulus: The inner radius must be smaller than the outer radius.
area.hint: All sizes use the same unit. A decimal comma works too.

volume.title: Volume calculator
volume.privacyNote: Volume and surface area of 12 solids, with the working, litres, gallons and cubic units.
volume.approx: ≈ The ellipsoid surface uses Knud Thomsen's approximation (within about 1%). The volume is exact.
volume.err_missing: Fill in every size for this solid.
volume.err_triangle: These sides do not make a triangle: the two shorter ones must add up to more than the longest.
volume.err_tube: The inner radius must be smaller than the outer radius.
volume.hint: All sizes use the same unit. A decimal comma works too.

randomLetter.title: Random letter generator
randomLetter.privacyNote: Draw random letters for word games, classrooms and quizzes. Every letter is equally likely.
randomLetter.err_empty: No letters are left to draw from. Remove some from Leave out.
randomLetter.err_count: How many must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
randomLetter.err_unique: With No repeats you can draw at most as many letters as there are to draw from.

wordUnscrambler.title: Word unscrambler
wordUnscrambler.privacyNote: Type your letters and see every English word they make, for word games, crosswords and anagrams.
wordUnscrambler.blankHint: Use ? for a blank tile (up to three). Letters can be in any order.
wordUnscrambler.listNote: Words come from ENABLE, a public-domain list of 172,823 English words used by many word games.
wordUnscrambler.empty: Type some letters to see the words they make.
wordUnscrambler.loadFailed: The word list did not load. Check your connection and type again.
wordUnscrambler.none: No words can be made from these letters with these filters.
wordUnscrambler.foundSome: {n} words found; the {shown} longest are shown.
wordUnscrambler.err_tooLong: Type at most {max} letters and blanks.

concrete.title: Concrete calculator
concrete.privacyNote: How much concrete a slab, footing, wall, column or set of stairs needs, and how many bags to buy.
concrete.hint: Each size can be in its own unit, for example feet for the length and inches for the thickness.
concrete.bagNote: Worked out from the usual yield of 0.60 ft³ per 80 lb bag (about 0.017 m³ per 36 kg) and rounded up. Check the yield printed on your bag.
concrete.err_count: {field} must be a whole number from 1 to 10,000.
concrete.err_inner: The inner diameter must be smaller than the outer one.
concrete.err_waste: Waste must be a percentage from 0 to 100.

graphingCalculator.title: Graphing calculator
graphingCalculator.privacyNote: Plot functions of x, move and zoom, and read off zeros, intercepts and where curves cross.
graphingCalculator.syntaxHint: Type x^2 for x², sqrt(x), abs(x), sin(x), ln(x), log(x), pi and e. 2x and 3(x+1) multiply. Angles are in radians.
graphingCalculator.err_syntax: This cannot be read as a function of x. Check the brackets and operators.
graphingCalculator.traceHint: Point at the graph (or tap it) to read the values. Drag to move; scroll or pinch to zoom.
graphingCalculator.noPoints: No zeros, intercepts or crossings in this view.
graphingCalculator.morePoints: More points in this view: zoom in to see them.

piano.title: Virtual piano
piano.privacyNote: Play with your computer keyboard, the mouse or your fingers. Press a key to start the sound.
piano.recording: Recording… play some notes, then press Stop.
piano.keyboardHint: Keys Z to M and Q to U play two octaves, with the rows above them for the black keys. Hold Space for the sustain pedal.
piano.noAudio: This browser cannot play sound from web pages.

slope.title: Slope calculator
slope.privacyNote: Type two points to get the slope, the line's equation, the distance and the midpoint, with the working.
slope.hint: Decimals, fractions such as 3/4 and mixed numbers such as 1 1/2 all work.
slope.graph: The two points and the line through them
slope.verticalStep: Δx = 0, so the line is vertical and its slope is undefined.
slope.err_missing: Fill in both coordinates of both points.
slope.err_invalid: {field} must be a number or a fraction such as 3/4.
slope.err_same: The two points are the same. Move one of them to make a line.
slope.allXIntercepts: Every point (the line is the x-axis)

sudoku.title: Sudoku
sudoku.privacyNote: Fill every row, column and 3 × 3 box with 1 to 9. Your game is saved in this browser.
sudoku.keys: Keyboard: arrows move, 1–9 enter, 0 or Backspace erases, N switches notes, Ctrl+Z undoes. Copy puzzle gives the 81-digit line other sudoku apps read.
sudoku.clash: The underlined digits repeat in a row, column or box.
sudoku.levelPending: Your game is kept. Tap New puzzle to start a {level} puzzle.

ticTacToe.title: Tic-tac-toe
ticTacToe.privacyNote: Get three in a row before the other side does.
ticTacToe.hint: Tip: start in a corner. On hard the computer never loses, so a draw is a good result.

colorBlindnessTest.title: Color blindness test
colorBlindnessTest.privacyNote: Type the number you see in each plate. Answers stay in this page.
colorBlindnessTest.err_answer: Type the one- or two-digit number, or tap I see no number.
colorBlindnessTest.r_demo: The first plate, which everyone should read, was missed. Check your screen settings and try again before reading anything into the result.
colorBlindnessTest.r_normal: No sign of a colour vision deficiency.
colorBlindnessTest.r_all: Several kinds of plates were missed. That can point to a colour vision deficiency, but it is often the screen: try again on another screen with filters turned off.
colorBlindnessTest.r_protan_mild: Signs of a mild red (protan) colour weakness.
colorBlindnessTest.r_protan_strong: Signs of a strong red (protan) colour deficiency.
colorBlindnessTest.r_deutan_mild: Signs of a mild green (deutan) colour weakness.
colorBlindnessTest.r_deutan_strong: Signs of a strong green (deutan) colour deficiency.
colorBlindnessTest.r_tritan_mild: Signs of a mild blue–yellow (tritan) colour weakness.
colorBlindnessTest.r_tritan_strong: Signs of a strong blue–yellow (tritan) colour deficiency.
colorBlindnessTest.disclaimer: This is a screening on an uncalibrated screen, not a diagnosis. Missing only the very faint plates is common. See an optometrist for a proper test.
colorBlindnessTest.tip1: Use full brightness and turn off night mode, blue-light and colour filters.
colorBlindnessTest.tip2: Look at each plate for no more than a few seconds.
colorBlindnessTest.tip3: If you wear glasses for reading or distance, wear them.

militaryTime.title: Military time converter
militaryTime.privacyNote: Type a time in military, 24-hour or 12-hour form to convert it.
militaryTime.err_invalid: That is not a time. Try 1430, 14:30 or 2:30 pm.

heightCalculator.title: Height calculator
heightCalculator.privacyNote: Estimate how tall a child will be from the parents' heights and, optionally, the child's height and age.
heightCalculator.childHint: Ages 2 to 20. Leave the height empty to use the parents' method alone.
heightCalculator.err_age: Age must be between 2 and 20 years, with months from 0 to 11.
heightCalculator.mainBoth: Predicted adult height: {parents} from the parents, {chart} from the growth chart
heightCalculator.stepRange: Range: the target ± {range} cm, where most children end up.
heightCalculator.stepPercentile: CDC growth chart: percentile {pct} now (z = {z}); the same z at 20 years is {result} cm.
heightCalculator.outside: The growth chart estimate is outside the parents' range. That is common in early or late puberty; a doctor can tell more.
heightCalculator.disclaimer: An estimate, not medical advice. Growth charts: CDC 2000 (United States).
